name: shared-spaces-sandbox
description: Test shared spaces from your own sandbox account with a synthetic demo teammate.

interface.longDescription: Stay signed in with your own sandbox account and test against a Demo Teammate with seeded shared and private memories. Includes a guided workflow for retrieval, selected sharing, author permissions, and incoming demo updates. Production uses a separate service and identity system.
defaultPrompt: Verify my own sandbox account and show my demo teammate's shared updates. Do not write until I ask.
Save a synthetic update as me and share it only in my Sandbox collaboration space.
Guide me through testing my own account against the demo teammate without switching users.
